final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT si.riskeval AS r, AVG(CAST(sc.gbsize AS REAL) / sc.spanmin) AS v FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref GROUP BY si.riskeval), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(v) AS m FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.r AS r, s1.v AS v, s1.v - s2.m AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.v > s2.m) SELECT AVG(v), AVG(d) FROM s3
